1.why: The interface uses a clean, readable sans-serif font with standard spacing.

2.why: Text formatting relies on plain styling and avoids dense or capitalized blocks.

3.why: Layout elements fit neatly within a standard mobile screen viewport.

4.why: Instructions are relatively short, though some technical terms appear.

5.why: Placeholder examples appear in certain recovery code fields but not all inputs.

6.why: Information is broken into small, digestible blocks across all screens.

7.why: Dedicated copy buttons are absent for long codes and secrets.

8.why: No QR code graphic is provided during the authenticator setup stage.

9.why: Standard form fields exist, but explicit autofill attributes are not verified.

10.why: Primary buttons are prominently styled in a high-contrast green color.

11.why: Each screen focuses on a single primary call-to-action button.

12.why: Status updates exist, but error feedback lacks helpful next steps.

13.why: Users can generate new codes or retry steps, though error prompts stack up.

14.why: Errors present raw technical stack details or generic messages without instructions.

15.why: No visible countdown timers block reading, though TOTP codes expire every 30 seconds.
